author: Multiplayer Everything
name: The Skullkid

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. The game starts once they have joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host clicks the menus. On the first floor each kid walks on their own; from the second floor on you walk as a team.

keys.does: Walk; Up and Down stand and duck on the shootout floor.

tips: The two kids share one health bar: losing restarts the floor for both.
Only the host's mouse works in the menus.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.
New: not yet played by people on two PCs or over the internet. Tell us how it runs.

description: The Skullkid (2002): two masked kids with chainsaws fight their way up an office building, floor by floor, to the boss.
